passed: Fresh installation automatically finds the video, enables CC and cold-starts real bundled EN/TR dual subtitles without opening any extension UI or checking any box
The actual toolbar popup is already checked on its first opening; no manual target, model load or activation step is needed
Caption changes and SPA video navigation automatically continue without re-enabling the switch or showing the previous caption translation
Reopening the popup retains on state before stopping and off state afterward; its control is above the fold, no target chooser is shown, and switching off restores native captions
Closing subtitles on the video also switches the persistent automatic mode off without resurrecting its overlay
The same automatic switch detects a second native TextTrack player and renders both original and real local translation without tab selection
scope: Local HTTPS YouTube-shaped fixture; real Firefox toolbar and packaged inference. No claim about blocked public YouTube.
